name: Create bucket
description: Creates a new bucket in a project under a globally unique name, with its location, storage class and optional default access settings.
notes: Every writable field is stored, including a validated location and ipFilter (stored, not enforced on requests); validate-projects checks the project through Resource Manager.

name: List buckets
description: Lists the buckets in a project and returns each bucket's resource with its name, location and settings.
notes: fake-gcs-server lists globally; LocalCloud filters recorded ownership.

name: Read bucket metadata
description: Reads one bucket's metadata resource, including its location, storage class, labels and settings such as versioning.
notes: Full modeled resource with per-bucket location; real project numbers with -validate-projects, otherwise stable synthetic ones; satisfiesPZS/satisfiesPZI are not reported.

name: Patch supported bucket attributes
description: Changes only the bucket fields included in the request, such as labels, versioning or the default object hold, and leaves the rest as they were.
notes: PATCH merges every modeled setting and null clears one.

name: Delete empty bucket
description: Permanently deletes a bucket after all of its objects have been removed.

name: Successful bucket deletion returns empty HTTP 204
description: A successful bucket deletion returns HTTP status 204 No Content with an empty response body.

name: Reject deleting a nonempty bucket
description: Refuses to delete a bucket that still contains objects and returns an error instead of removing the bucket or its contents.

name: Validate bucket names on JSON creation
description: Checks a new bucket name against the naming rules, such as length limits, allowed characters, no IP address form and no goog prefix.
notes: Every documented local name rule; global uniqueness and domain-ownership verification need Google.

name: Bucket-list prefix filtering
description: Narrows a bucket listing to buckets whose names begin with a given string.

name: Bucket-list pagination
description: Returns a long bucket listing in pages, using a maximum page size and a page token to continue from the previous page.

name: Associate a new bucket with its requested project
description: Attaches a newly created bucket to the project named in the request, making that project the bucket's owner.
notes: JSON and gRPC creates record the project; validate-projects resolves existence and number through the official Resource Manager client.

name: Filter bucket listing by recorded project
description: Scopes a bucket listing to one project, so only buckets owned by the project named in the request are returned.
notes: JSON and gRPC listings filter by project ID or number; default-project attributes seeded and implicitly created buckets.

name: Object Versioning
description: A bucket setting that keeps older generations of an object as noncurrent versions when it is overwritten or deleted, so they can be listed and restored.
notes: Memory and filesystem; filesystem history survives restarts.

name: Default event-based object hold
description: A bucket setting that places an event-based hold on every new object, which cannot be deleted or replaced until the hold is released.
notes: New objects receive the hold, which blocks delete and overwrite.

name: Read storage layout endpoint
description: Returns where a bucket stores its data and whether hierarchical namespace is on: its name, location, location type and namespace setting.

name: Enable hierarchical namespace
description: Creates a bucket with hierarchical namespace turned on, which organizes objects into real folders and allows atomic folder renames. It can be chosen only at creation.
notes: Chosen at creation, requires uniform access, reported by the storage layout.

name: List bucket ACL entries
description: Lists the access control entries on a bucket, each pairing an entity such as a user or group with a role.

name: Read one bucket ACL entry
description: Reads the single access control entry that grants one named entity a role on a bucket.

name: Insert bucket ACL entry
description: Adds an access control entry to a bucket, granting a user, group, domain or special group a role such as reader or owner.

name: Update bucket ACL entry
description: Replaces the role of an existing bucket access control entry for an entity, using a full PUT request.

name: Delete bucket ACL entry
description: Removes the access control entry for a named entity from a bucket, ending the access that entry granted.

name: Expand predefined bucket ACLs
description: Lets a create request name a predefined ACL set, such as private or publicRead, which expands into the full list of bucket access entries.
notes: Every predefined bucket and default object ACL expands to Google's entries, project teams named by number.

name: Replace bucket metadata with buckets.update (PUT)
description: Updates a bucket's metadata with a PUT request, which can change fields the request does not mention; patch is generally preferred.
notes: PUT resets omitted settings; ACLs, IAM and soft delete change only when named.

name: Bucket-specific CORS configuration
description: A bucket setting listing the origins, methods and response headers that browsers may use for cross-origin requests, plus a preflight cache time.
notes: XML API preflight and response headers; unconfigured buckets keep the emulator's permissive default.

name: Choose and enforce a real bucket storage location
description: The location chosen when a bucket is created, a region, dual-region or multi-region, which sets where its data is stored and affects availability, price and latency.
notes: Locations validated against Google's list, stored per bucket and enforced for CMEK keys; no physical data placement.

name: Object Lifecycle Management rules
description: Rules that automatically act on objects when conditions such as age or number of newer versions are met, for example deleting them or changing their storage class.
notes: Delete, SetStorageClass and AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload over the documented conditions, run on demand or on an interval.

name: Bucket retention policy
description: A bucket setting that sets the minimum time objects must be kept before they can be deleted or replaced, given as a retention period in seconds.
notes: Blocks delete, overwrite and move until expiry.

name: Lock bucket retention policy
description: Permanently locks a bucket's retention policy so it can no longer be removed or shortened. The request must name the bucket's current metageneration.
notes: Requires ifMetagenerationMatch; locked policy can only lengthen; persisted.

name: Configure soft-delete policy
description: A bucket setting that keeps deleted objects recoverable for a set number of seconds before they are permanently removed; zero turns it off.
notes: 0 or 7 to 90 days; new buckets default to disabled where Google defaults to 7 days.

name: Restore soft-deleted bucket
description: Brings a soft-deleted bucket back to live status, identified by its generation number, with its metadata but not its objects.
notes: By generation; conflict while the name is live; soft-deleted objects stay restorable.

name: Patch one bucket ACL entry
description: Changes part of a single bucket access control entry for an entity with a PATCH request, rather than replacing the whole entry.
notes: Validates entity and role; missing entry is 404.

name: Read object metadata
description: Returns an object's metadata, such as its size, content type, checksums, generation and storage class, without its data.

name: Download object bytes
description: Returns an object's stored bytes rather than its metadata when a get request asks for media content.

name: HEAD object/download requests
description: Returns only the headers of an object, such as size, content type and checksums, with no body, using an XML API HEAD request.

name: Download byte ranges
description: Returns only a requested byte range of an object through the Range header, useful for resuming a download or reading part of a file.

name: Gzip download transcoding
description: Decompresses an object stored with gzip content encoding while serving it, unless the client says it accepts gzip, so the client receives the original bytes.

name: Preserve compressed download when requested
description: Serves a gzip-encoded object still compressed, with a gzip content-encoding header, when the request accepts gzip or the object is marked no-transform.

name: Download response-header overrides
description: Lets an authenticated download request override the content type or content disposition returned for that one response without changing the stored object.
notes: Overrides apply to authenticated XML GETs (Authorization header or signed URL) only; HEAD and JSON media downloads ignore them, where Google is silent.

name: List objects
description: Retrieves the objects stored in a bucket as a list of object resources with their metadata.

name: Object-list prefix filtering
description: Returns only objects whose names begin with a given prefix, for example everything under a folder-like path.

name: Object-list delimiter/common prefixes
description: Groups object names at a delimiter, usually a slash, returning names without the delimiter as items and shared leading parts as prefixes, to mimic directories.

name: Object-list matchGlob filtering
description: Returns only objects whose names match a glob pattern, which can use wildcards to select names across path levels.

name: Reject invalid matchGlob patterns
description: Responds with an error when the matchGlob value in a listing request is not a valid glob pattern.

name: Object-list start offset
description: Returns only objects whose names sort at or after the given value, an inclusive lower bound that begins a name range.

name: Object-list end offset
description: Returns only objects whose names sort before the given value, an exclusive upper bound that ends a name range.

name: Include trailing delimiter objects
description: When listing with a delimiter, also returns the metadata of objects whose names end with that delimiter, in addition to listing them as prefixes.

name: Object-list pagination
description: Returns a long object listing in pages, with a maximum page size and a page token for the next page; each page counts objects and prefixes together.
notes: Objects and prefixes share maxResults; opaque position tokens.

name: List historical object generations
description: Includes every stored generation of each object, not only the live one, as separate results ordered by increasing generation when versions are requested.
notes: Memory and filesystem.

name: Read a specified historical generation
description: Reads the metadata or data of one particular generation of an object, identified by its generation number, rather than the latest version.
notes: Memory and filesystem.

name: Delete object
description: Removes an object and its metadata from a bucket; with versioning or soft delete turned on, the data can remain recoverable.

name: Successful object deletion returns empty HTTP 204
description: A successful object deletion returns HTTP status 204 No Content with an empty response body.

name: Delete a specified object generation
description: Permanently deletes one specific generation of an object by naming its generation number, leaving other generations in place.
notes: Memory and filesystem; a soft-delete policy keeps it recoverable.

name: Copy object with copyTo
description: Copies a source object to a destination name in a single request, optionally overriding metadata; the copy does not keep the source object's ACLs.

name: Rewrite object with rewriteTo
description: Copies a source object to a destination in one or more calls, returning a rewrite token to continue until the work is done, and can override metadata.

name: Compose objects
description: Concatenates up to 32 existing objects from one bucket into a single new object in that bucket, leaving the sources unchanged by default.

name: Patch object metadata
description: Updates only the metadata fields named in the request, such as custom metadata or retention, and leaves other fields unchanged.
notes: holds, retention, ACLs, custom time and object contexts.

name: Replace object metadata using PUT objects.update
description: Updates an object's metadata with a PUT request, which can change metadata fields that the request does not mention; patch is generally preferred.
notes: PUT resets omitted writable fields and refuses to drop customTime; ACL, storage class and retention are kept when omitted, where Google is silent.

name: PATCH through X-HTTP-Method-Override
description: Lets a client that cannot send PATCH use a POST request with the method override header set to PATCH to apply a patch-style update.
notes: POST override to PATCH.

name: Store custom metadata entries
description: Lets users attach their own key and value pairs to an object, sent as x-goog-meta headers in the XML API, and returns them with the object.

name: Store content type
description: Records the object's media type, such as image/png, which tells browsers and clients how to interpret its bytes.

name: Store content encoding
description: Records that an object's bytes are compressed, for example with gzip, while the content type still describes the underlying file.

name: Store content disposition
description: Records how a browser should present the object, such as showing it inline or offering it as a download with a given file name.

name: Store content language
description: Records the language or languages an object is intended for, using language codes such as en or fr.

name: Store cache-control metadata
description: Records caching directives such as max-age or no-transform that control whether caches may store the object and for how long.

name: Store custom time
description: Records a user-chosen timestamp on an object, used by lifecycle rules that act a number of days after that time; once set it cannot be moved earlier.

name: Object response projection
description: Controls how much of an object's metadata a response includes: full returns every property, while noAcl leaves out the owner and access control list.

name: Object retention mode/retain-until handling
description: Sets a per-object retention mode, unlocked or locked, and a retain-until time before which the object cannot be deleted or replaced.
notes: Requires bucket object retention; locked only extends; shortening unlocked needs override; blocks deletion.

name: List object ACL entries
description: Lists the access control entries on an object, each granting an entity a role on that object.

name: Read one object ACL entry
description: Reads the single access control entry for a named entity on an object, for the latest generation or a specified one.

name: Insert object ACL entry
description: Adds an access control entry to an object, granting a user, group or special group a role such as reader or owner on it.

name: Update object ACL entry
description: Replaces the role of an existing object access control entry for an entity, using a full PUT request.

name: Delete object ACL entry
description: Removes the access control entry for a named entity from an object, ending the access that entry granted.

name: Generation-specific object ACL lookup
description: Looks up an object's access control entry for one specific generation of the object by passing its generation number, instead of the latest version.
notes: Memory and filesystem.

name: Predefined object ACLs on upload/copy/compose
description: Applies a predefined access set such as private, publicRead or bucketOwnerRead to an object when it is uploaded, copied or composed.
notes: Google's entries for every predefined object ACL, with the owner entry on uploads, copy, compose, rewrite and restore.

name: XML object listing
description: Lists the objects in a bucket through the XML API as a ListBucketResult document, with Contents entries, common prefixes and truncation markers.
notes: V1 markers and list-type=2 continuation, start-after, fetch-owner, encoding and both version-listing formats; Owner is the ACL owner entity.

name: Virtual-hosted object download
description: Downloads an object through the XML API from an address where the bucket name forms part of the host name and the object name is the path.

name: Path-style object download
description: Downloads an object through the XML API from an address where the bucket name is the first segment of the path after the host.

name: Virtual-hosted object DELETE route
description: Deletes an object with an XML API DELETE request sent to an address whose host name begins with the bucket name.

name: Patch one object ACL entry
description: Changes part of a single object access control entry with a PATCH request, rather than replacing the whole entry.
notes: Entry must exist; changes the addressed generation in place.

name: Restore a soft-deleted object
description: Restores a soft-deleted object by creating a new live copy in the same bucket from a named generation, with the metadata it had before deletion.
notes: New generation; overwrites a live object; copySourceAcl.

name: Increment metageneration on metadata changes
description: Raises an object's metageneration counter by one each time its metadata changes, starting at 1 for each new generation, so conditional requests can detect changes.
notes: Persisted by both backends.

name: Use customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK)
description: Encrypts an object with a symmetric Cloud KMS key you control, named per request or set as the bucket default, instead of a Google-managed key.
notes: built-in key service by default or Cloud KMS envelope encryption through the official client (-kms cloud); keys must match the bucket location; Google documents no status for a denied key permission (403 used).

name: Use customer-supplied encryption keys (CSEK)
description: Encrypts an object with your own AES-256 key supplied in request headers on each operation; Google keeps only a hash of the key afterwards.
notes: AES-256 at rest on JSON, XML, form, multipart and gRPC paths with Google's error reasons; checksums shown only with the key; keys sent over plain HTTP are not refused.

name: Default object ACL: list
description: Lists the default object access control entries of a bucket, which apply to new objects created in the bucket without their own ACL.

name: Default object ACL: get
description: Reads the default object access control entry for one named entity on a bucket.

name: Default object ACL: insert
description: Adds an entry to a bucket's default object ACL, granting an entity a role on new objects that are created without an ACL.
notes: New objects without a predefined ACL inherit it.

name: Default object ACL: update
description: Replaces the role in an existing default object ACL entry for an entity, using a full PUT request.

name: Default object ACL: patch
description: Changes part of a default object ACL entry for an entity with a PATCH request, rather than replacing the whole entry.

name: Default object ACL: delete
description: Removes the default object ACL entry for an entity, so new objects no longer receive that grant.

name: Simple/media upload
description: Uploads an object's bytes in a single request, sending no metadata, with the object name given as a query parameter.

name: Multipart JSON upload
description: Uploads an object's data together with its metadata in one multipart request, so content type and custom metadata are set at creation.

name: Resumable upload initiation
description: Starts a resumable upload by sending the object name and optional metadata, and returns a session URI that later requests use to send the data.

name: Resumable upload chunks/finalization
description: Sends data to the session URI in chunks with a Content-Range header, receiving a 308 response until the final chunk completes the object with 200 or 201.

name: Resumable upload cancellation
description: Cancels an unfinished resumable upload by sending DELETE to its session URI; the JSON API answers 499 and the session cannot be used again.
notes: Session invalidated; 499 without a body; later chunks and status checks get 404.

name: Multipart form object upload
description: Uploads one object from an HTML form with a POST request, where the form carries the object name, an optional signed policy and the file as its last field.

name: Gzipped upload content
description: Uploads content that is already gzip-compressed, usually with its content encoding set to gzip, so it is stored compressed and can be transcoded on download.

name: Calculate MD5 checksum
description: Produces a base64 MD5 hash of an object's data, returned in its metadata, for checking integrity; composite objects do not have one.

name: Calculate CRC32C checksum
description: Produces a CRC32C checksum of an object's data, returned in its metadata, which is the recommended hash for integrity checks.

name: Validate declared MD5 on upload
description: Rejects an upload whose data does not match the MD5 hash declared in the request, so corrupted transfers are not stored.

name: Validate declared CRC32C on upload
description: Rejects an upload whose data does not match the CRC32C checksum declared in the request, failing the write instead of storing corrupted data.

name: ifGenerationMatch precondition
description: Runs a request only if the object's current generation equals the given number; zero means it succeeds only when no live object exists.

name: ifGenerationNotMatch precondition
description: Runs a request only if the object's current generation differs from the given number, which guards against acting on one particular version.
notes: Fails on a missing object; failed reads answer 304.

name: ifMetagenerationMatch precondition
description: Runs a request only if the object's metageneration equals the given number, which detects metadata changes made since it was read.
notes: Real metageneration, answered under the backend lock for patch and update.

name: ifMetagenerationNotMatch precondition
description: Runs a request only if the object's metageneration differs from the given number, which shows whether metadata has changed since it was last read.
notes: Real metageneration; failed reads answer 304.

name: Copy/rewrite source generation conditions
description: Makes a copy or rewrite proceed only if the source object's generation matches ifSourceGenerationMatch, so the intended version is the one copied.

name: Copy/rewrite source metageneration conditions
description: Makes a copy or rewrite proceed only if the source object's metageneration matches ifSourceMetagenerationMatch.
notes: Real source metageneration.

name: JSON batch requests
description: Combines several JSON API calls into one HTTP request, up to 100 calls in a multipart body, and returns one response part for each call.

name: Inherit outer Authorization header into batch subrequests
description: Applies the Authorization header of the outer batch request to every inner call unless a call sets its own, so credentials are given once.
notes: LocalCloud copies standard Authorization; local identity headers are not GCS features.

name: Import x-goog-meta-* upload headers
description: Turns request headers beginning with x-goog-meta- into the custom metadata of the uploaded object, through the XML API.

name: Import x-amz-meta-* simple-upload headers
description: Treats Amazon S3 style x-amz-meta headers on an XML API upload as custom metadata, matching x-goog-meta headers, for S3 interoperability.
notes: XML S3-interoperability spelling; not full S3 support.

name: Preserve declared checksums across resumable chunks
description: Validates a checksum declared on the final request of a resumable upload against the whole object assembled from all of its chunks.
notes: Retains full session entry.

name: Continue resumable upload using bearer session URI
description: Lets whoever holds a resumable upload's session URI continue that upload without further credentials, because the URI acts as an authentication token.
notes: The session URI is the credential until expiry or cancellation, also after the initiating key is revoked; a configured authorization callback is still consulted.

name: JSON objects.move / moveTo endpoint
description: Renames an object within its bucket by moving it from a source name to a destination name, replacing any object already at the destination.
notes: preconditions, projection, holds and retention, with atomicity and events per M02 and M11; Autoclass is not modeled.

name: All-or-nothing atomic object move
description: Performs the whole move as one atomic transaction, so either every step completes or no change is made.

name: Move source ifSourceGenerationMatch precondition
description: Moves the source only when its generation matches ifSourceGenerationMatch, guarding against moving a version that changed since it was read.

name: Move destination ifGenerationMatch precondition
description: Moves only when the live destination object has the generation given in ifGenerationMatch; zero means the destination must not already exist.

name: Move source ifSourceMetagenerationMatch precondition
description: Moves the source only when its metageneration matches ifSourceMetagenerationMatch, guarding against metadata changed since it was read.
notes: Real metageneration.

name: Move destination ifMetagenerationMatch precondition
description: Moves only when the live destination object's metageneration matches ifMetagenerationMatch.
notes: Real metageneration.

name: Preserve source metadata during move
description: Keeps the source object's data and metadata on the destination, apart from its name, generation, metageneration and timestamps.

name: Assign fresh destination generation on move
description: Gives the destination object a new generation number and resets its metageneration to 1, because the move creates a new object.

name: Leave data unchanged on failed move preconditions
description: Leaves both the source and the destination unchanged when a move fails because a precondition is not met.

name: Move source notification semantics
description: Determines which Pub/Sub notification event is published for the object at its original name when a move takes it away.
notes: Source DELETE, or ARCHIVE under versioning (soft delete does not apply); replaced destination ARCHIVE or DELETE; new object FINALIZE.

name: Emit destination finalize event on move
description: Publishes an object finalize notification for the destination object that a move creates.

name: Emit overwritten-destination event on move
description: Publishes a delete or archive notification for an existing object at the destination name when a move replaces it.

name: Move source ifSourceGenerationNotMatch precondition
description: Moves the source only when its generation differs from ifSourceGenerationNotMatch.
notes: Metadata conditions use fixed metageneration.

name: Move destination ifGenerationNotMatch precondition
description: Moves only when a live destination object exists whose generation differs from ifGenerationNotMatch.
notes: Metadata conditions use fixed metageneration.

name: Move source ifSourceMetagenerationNotMatch precondition
description: Moves the source only when its metageneration differs from ifSourceMetagenerationNotMatch.
notes: Real metageneration.

name: Move destination ifMetagenerationNotMatch precondition
description: Moves only when the live destination object's metageneration differs from ifMetagenerationNotMatch.
notes: Real metageneration.

name: Reject moving retention-protected source or destination
description: Fails a move with a 403 retention error when the source or a live destination object is under an object or bucket retention policy.
notes: Holds and retention block either side.

name: Enforce resource IAM permissions on JSON/XML requests
description: Checks that the caller holds the IAM permission each JSON or XML request needs on the bucket or object, and rejects the request if it does not.
notes: opt-in local evaluator applies bucket, managed-folder and (with -validate-projects) project policies, or the external callback; no organization or folder inheritance, deny policies, custom role definitions or conditions on project bindings.

name: Require delete permission when overwriting
description: Requires the delete permission as well as create when an upload replaces an existing object.
notes: Create and delete checked by the local evaluator and the callback.

name: Check source-read permission for compose
description: Requires permission to read every source object, as well as create permission on the destination, when composing objects.
notes: Read checked on every compose source by the local evaluator and the callback.

name: Use IAM administration permissions for ACL routes
description: Requires the IAM administration permissions to read or change ACLs on buckets and objects, such as getIamPolicy and setIamPolicy.
notes: ACL routes need the get/update and getIamPolicy/setIamPolicy permissions Google lists.

name: Authorize XML requests as the HMAC key's service account
description: Treats a request signed with an HMAC key as made by the service account or user that owns the key, so that identity's IAM permissions apply.
notes: Requests act as the key's service account; with -validate-service-accounts keys stop while the account is disabled and go with it when it is deleted.

name: Read bucket IAM policy
description: Returns the IAM policy of a bucket: its role bindings, optional conditions, policy version and etag.
notes: Default legacy bindings, policy versions and etags.

name: Set bucket IAM policy
description: Replaces a bucket's IAM policy with the one supplied, granting or removing roles for members.
notes: Validates roles and members; etag concurrency; conditions require version 3.

name: Test bucket IAM permissions
description: Returns which of the listed permissions the caller holds on a bucket, without needing any permission itself.
notes: Returns the caller's effective permissions.

name: Uniform bucket-level access
description: A bucket setting that disables ACLs so access is controlled only through IAM, and that cannot be turned off once it has been on for 90 days.
notes: ACL API rejected and ACLs ignored; disabling only before the lock time.

name: Public access prevention
description: A bucket or organization setting that stops buckets and objects from being made public through IAM or ACLs, so allUsers grants have no effect.
notes: Bucket setting enforced; organization policy not modeled.

name: Create HMAC key
description: Creates an HMAC key for a service account and returns the key's access ID and its secret in the response.
notes: With -validate-service-accounts the account must exist in IAM Admin (official client); otherwise the email shape and project are checked.

name: List HMAC key metadata
description: Returns metadata for the HMAC keys in a project, without their secrets.

name: Read HMAC key metadata
description: Returns the metadata of one HMAC key by its access ID, including its state and service account, but not its secret.

name: Update HMAC key active/inactive state
description: Changes an HMAC key's state to active or inactive; permanent removal is done with the delete method.

name: Delete an inactive HMAC key
description: Permanently removes an HMAC key whose state is inactive, making it unusable and unrecoverable.

name: Reject key deletion while active
description: Returns an error if a request tries to delete an HMAC key that is still active, so a key must be made inactive first.

name: Filter HMAC listing by service-account email
description: Narrows an HMAC key listing to the keys that belong to one service account, identified by its email address.

name: Paginate HMAC listing
description: Returns a long HMAC key listing in pages, using a maximum page size and a page token to continue.

name: Include deleted keys when requested
description: Includes keys in the DELETED state in an HMAC key listing, which are left out by default.

name: Validate update etag when supplied
description: Accepts an etag with a key update and applies the change only if it matches the key's current etag, guarding against overwriting a concurrent change.

name: Return key secret only on creation
description: Shows an HMAC key's secret only in the response that creates it; later reads return metadata alone, so a lost secret cannot be retrieved.

name: Enforce ten nondeleted keys per service account
description: Limits each service account to 10 HMAC keys that are not deleted; deleted keys do not count toward the limit.

name: Invalidate HMAC keys when owning service account is deleted
description: Deletes a service account's HMAC keys when the account itself is deleted, though they may keep working for a short time afterwards.
notes: With -validate-service-accounts a deleted account's keys are deleted, after a cache window of up to 10 seconds.

name: Verify RSA signed URL signature
description: Checks the signature on a signed URL created with an RSA private key using GOOG4-RSA-SHA256, so only URLs signed by a valid key are accepted.
notes: Verified when signer public keys are configured; unverified otherwise.

name: Enforce RSA signed URL expiration
description: Rejects a signed URL once its expiration time has passed; a V4 URL can be valid for at most 7 days.
notes: At most 7 days; checked against the server clock when keys are configured.

name: Verify GOOG1 V2 Authorization header
description: Validates an Authorization header of the form GOOG1 followed by an access ID and a V2 signature computed with an HMAC key's secret.

name: Verify AWS V2 Authorization header
description: Validates an Authorization header of the form AWS followed by an access ID and a V2 signature, as sent by S3 style clients.

name: Verify Google V2 HMAC signed URL
description: Validates a V2 signed URL that carries GoogleAccessId, Expires and Signature query parameters and is signed with an HMAC key.

name: Verify GOOG4-HMAC-SHA256 Authorization header
description: Validates an Authorization header that uses GOOG4-HMAC-SHA256, whose signature is made with a signing key derived from an HMAC secret.

name: Verify AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Authorization header
description: Validates an Authorization header that uses AWS4-HMAC-SHA256, the Amazon S3 style V4 signature accepted for XML API interoperability.

name: Verify Google V4 HMAC signed URL
description: Validates a V4 signed URL made with GOOG4-HMAC-SHA256 and its X-Goog-Algorithm, Credential, Date, Expires, SignedHeaders and Signature query parameters.

name: Verify AWS V4 HMAC signed URL
description: Validates a signed URL made with the AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 algorithm of Amazon S3 style V4 signing, accepted by the XML API for interoperability.

name: Reject expired HMAC signed URLs
description: Rejects an HMAC signed URL whose expiration time has already passed, so access ends when the URL expires.

name: Check HMAC header request time window
description: Checks that the timestamp in a signed request's date header falls within an allowed window around the server's current time, rejecting stale or future requests.
notes: 15 minutes.

name: Verify V4 signed headers
description: Checks that the signature covers the headers named in the signed headers list, including the mandatory host header, so those headers cannot be altered.
notes: Host required.

name: Verify declared V4 payload SHA256 (allow UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD)
description: Checks the payload hash declared in a V4 request against the body, and also allows the value UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD to skip hashing the payload.
notes: Unsigned payload is permitted by the Google contract.

name: Verify signed-request Content-MD5 when supplied
description: Includes the Content-MD5 header in the signed data when a request has one, so a changed body digest invalidates the signature.

name: Verify V2 HMAC form policy signature
description: Validates an HTML form upload policy signed with the V2 scheme, using the GoogleAccessId, Base64 policy and signature form fields.

name: Verify V4 HMAC form policy signature
description: Validates an HTML form upload policy signed with the V4 scheme, using the x-goog-algorithm, credential, date and signature form fields.

name: Enforce form policy expiration
description: Rejects a form upload when the policy document's expiration time has passed, so a form stops working after its validity window.

name: Enforce form policy equality conditions
description: Requires a form field to equal the exact value given in a policy condition, such as a fixed content type or object name.

name: Enforce form policy prefix conditions
description: Requires a form field to start with the value given in a starts-with policy condition, such as an object name prefix.

name: Enforce form policy content-length range
description: Requires the uploaded file's size to fall between the minimum and maximum bytes set by a content-length-range policy condition.

name: Require policy coverage of bucket and key
description: Requires a form policy to contain conditions covering every submitted form field, including bucket and key, so uploads cannot be redirected.

name: Reject unknown/inactive HMAC credentials
description: Rejects a request signed with an access ID that does not exist or whose HMAC key is inactive or deleted.
notes: And.

name: Reject malformed signed XML authentication
description: Rejects a request whose XML API authentication data is malformed, such as a broken Authorization header or missing signature parameters.
notes: Exercised without optional IAM callback.

name: Create notification configuration
description: Creates a notification configuration on a bucket that sends Pub/Sub messages to a topic for chosen events, with a payload format and optional filters.
notes: Full resource; 10 per event type and 100 per bucket.

name: List notification configurations
description: Returns all notification configurations defined on a bucket.

name: Read notification configuration
description: Returns one notification configuration of a bucket by its ID, including its topic, event types and payload format.
notes: etag, selfLink and canonical topic.

name: Delete notification configuration
description: Deletes a notification configuration by its ID so the bucket stops publishing messages for it.

name: Deliver notifications to Pub/Sub
description: Publishes a message to the configured Pub/Sub topic whenever a matching change happens to an object in the bucket.
notes: JSON, XML, upload, gRPC and lifecycle changes publish through the official Pub/Sub client (PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST or the production service).

name: Filter notifications by event type
description: Limits a configuration to chosen event types, for example only finalize and delete; an empty list sends every event type.

name: Filter notifications by object-name prefix
description: Limits a configuration to objects whose names start with a given prefix, so other objects do not trigger messages.

name: JSON_API_V1 notification payload
description: Sends a payload that is the object's metadata resource as a UTF-8 JSON string in the message body.

name: NONE notification payload
description: Sends the message with no payload, leaving only the event details in the message attributes.

name: Custom notification attributes
description: Adds user-defined key and value pairs to the attributes of every message that a configuration publishes.

name: OBJECT_FINALIZE events
description: Fires when a new object, or a new generation of an existing object, is successfully created, including by copy, rewrite or restore.

name: OBJECT_DELETE events
description: Fires when an object is permanently deleted, including when it is replaced or removed by a lifecycle rule.

name: OBJECT_METADATA_UPDATE events
description: Fires when the metadata of an existing object changes, for example after a patch or update.

name: OBJECT_ARCHIVE events
description: Fires when a live object becomes noncurrent, which happens only in a bucket with Object Versioning, for example on overwrite or delete.
notes: overwrite, delete and move in versioned buckets on both backends.

name: Validate notification topic at creation
description: Rejects a new configuration whose Pub/Sub topic is malformed, does not exist or cannot be published to by Cloud Storage.
notes: With -validate-notification-topics the topic must exist and accept publishing (403 forbidden otherwise), through the official Pub/Sub client.

name: Validate notification payload format at creation
description: Rejects a new configuration whose payload format is anything other than JSON_API_V1 or NONE.

name: Validate configured event types at creation
description: Rejects a new configuration that lists an event type Cloud Storage does not recognize.

name: Enforce custom attribute count limit
description: Allows at most 10 custom attributes on one notification configuration and rejects a configuration that has more.
notes: At most ten.

name: At-least-once notification delivery guarantee
description: Cloud Storage guarantees at-least-once delivery of each notification to Pub/Sub, so duplicate messages are possible and order is not guaranteed.
notes: Every change records an intent before the write, replayed after a crash with filesystem storage; duplicates possible, as Google allows.

name: Retry failed notification publications
description: Retries publishing a notification that fails to reach Pub/Sub; one that stays undeliverable may be deleted after 7 days.
notes: Persistent queue retries with capped backoff; a configuration failing for 7 days is deleted; Google publishes no backoff schedule.

name: Notification payload reflects the triggering object change
description: Builds each message's payload from the object's metadata after the triggering change, so it describes the object as of that event.
notes: LocalCloud snapshots payload before async delivery.

name: Include notification configuration identifier in attributes
description: Adds a notificationConfig attribute to every message, identifying the configuration that produced it.

name: Include deletion time in delete-event payload
description: For delete events with a JSON payload, includes the object's metadata from before deletion plus a timeDeleted property.

name: Enforce 100 notification configurations per bucket
description: Allows at most 100 notification configurations on a bucket in total.

name: Enforce ten configurations per event type per bucket
description: Allows at most 10 notification configurations on a bucket that trigger on the same event type.
notes: A configuration without event types counts for every type.

name: Hierarchical folder: insert
description: Creates a folder in a bucket with hierarchical namespace, and can also create any missing parent folders when the recursive option is set.
notes: Recursive creates parents.

name: Hierarchical folder: get
description: Returns the metadata of one folder in a bucket with hierarchical namespace, identified by its name.

name: Hierarchical folder: list
description: Lists the folders in a bucket with hierarchical namespace, optionally under a prefix that ends in a slash, one page at a time.
notes: prefix, delimiter, offsets and paging.

name: Hierarchical folder: rename
description: Renames a folder and everything in it as a long-running operation that cannot be canceled once it has started.
notes: long-running operation with Google's metadata, crash-atomic on disk; it completes before the response, so done is already true.

name: Hierarchical folder: delete
description: Deletes a folder from a bucket with hierarchical namespace; the folder must be empty, and any managed folder attached to it is deleted too.
notes: Must be empty.

name: Managed folder: insert
description: Creates a managed folder in a bucket, a named prefix that can carry its own IAM policy to control access to the objects under it.

name: Managed folder: get
description: Returns the metadata of one managed folder, identified by its path within the bucket.

name: Managed folder: list
description: Lists the managed folders in a bucket, optionally only those whose names begin with a prefix, one page at a time.
notes: Prefix and paging.

name: Managed folder: delete
description: Deletes a managed folder; the allowNonEmpty option allows deleting it even while it still contains objects or other managed folders.
notes: allowNonEmpty.

name: Managed folder: getIamPolicy
description: Returns the IAM policy attached to a managed folder, which controls access to the objects under it.

name: Managed folder: setIamPolicy
description: Replaces the IAM policy attached to a managed folder, changing who can access the objects under it.
notes: Inherited by objects under the prefix.

name: Managed folder: testIamPermissions
description: Returns which of the listed permissions the caller holds on a managed folder.

name: Storage v2 gRPC GetBucket
description: Returns the metadata of one bucket named in the request, through the Storage v2 gRPC API.

name: Storage v2 gRPC CreateBucket
description: Creates a new bucket in a project from the bucket details supplied in the request.

name: Storage v2 gRPC DeleteBucket
description: Permanently deletes a bucket that holds no objects, identified by its name in the request.

name: Storage v2 gRPC UpdateBucket
description: Updates a bucket by applying a patch-style change to only the fields named in the request.

name: Storage v2 gRPC ListBuckets
description: Retrieves the buckets of a project, ordered lexicographically by name.
notes: Filters by the parent project and rejects an unknown one.

name: Storage v2 gRPC GetObject
description: Retrieves an object's metadata, such as size, content type and checksums, without its data.

name: Storage v2 gRPC DeleteObject
description: Deletes an object and its metadata; depending on versioning and soft delete, the deletion can be permanent or recoverable.

name: Storage v2 gRPC UpdateObject
description: Updates an object's metadata, equivalent to the JSON API patch method.

name: Storage v2 gRPC ListObjects
description: Retrieves the objects in a bucket that match the criteria in the request, such as a prefix or delimiter.

name: Storage v2 gRPC ComposeObject
description: Concatenates a list of existing objects into a new object in the same bucket.

name: Storage v2 gRPC ReadObject
description: Retrieves an object's data as a stream of messages, and can start at an offset and stop at a limit.
notes: customer-supplied and Cloud KMS keys decrypt per request.

name: Storage v2 gRPC WriteObject
description: Stores a new object and its metadata, with the data sent from the client as a stream of messages.
notes: client-streaming and bidirectional writes; encrypt with customer-supplied, request or bucket-default Cloud KMS keys.

name: Storage v2 gRPC StartResumableWrite
description: Starts a resumable write and returns an upload ID that later write calls use to continue the upload.

name: Storage v2 gRPC QueryWriteStatus
description: Reports the persisted size of an object that is still being written, so an interrupted upload knows where to resume.
